# BrightRoom Proposal

Thank you for your enquiry. Your group of 13 doesn't fit within the €400 budget as asked, so here is what we can offer.

## The constraint
- **Studio (€240)** holds a maximum of **12 people**, so it can't host 13.
- **Loft (€420)** is the only venue for 13 people. The venue alone is already over €400.

## Option A: Loft, full group of 13 (recommended if all 13 must attend)
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Loft, 4 hours (up to 24 people, wheelchair accessible, Wi-Fi) | €420 |
| Coffee break × 13 (€8 each) | €104 |
| **Total** | **€524** |

This is **€124 over your budget**. We have no discounts or shorter-duration pricing, so I can't lower this figure.

## Option B: Studio, if the group can be 12 people
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Studio, 4 hours (max 12 people, Wi-Fi) | €240 |
| Coffee break × 12 (€8 each) | €96 |
| **Total** | **€336** |

This is **€64 under budget**. Optionally, add a projector (€35) for a **total of €371**, still within budget.

Please note that the Studio is **stairs only and not wheelchair accessible**. It is only suitable if no attendee needs step-free access.

## Next steps
- Please confirm which option suits you, and whether any attendee needs wheelchair access.
- Send us your preferred **date**. Availability must be checked separately, and nothing is reserved until it is confirmed.

All prices are final totals in euros, with no taxes or extra fees.
